text:
Schaefer's 1947 "Electrical Indicator of Mechanical Expansion" patent was most likely issued with Irving Langmuir, his General Electric colleague and mentor. This matches the team note, which limits the answer to Langmuir or Blodgett. Langmuir worked closely with Schaefer on the cloud-seeding research in the 1940s. My earlier guess of Vonnegut isn't one of the allowed options, so I'm dropping it.

CONFIDENCE: 66
